text:
Maya (PM): Quick sync — plan to onboard a small set of design partners to validate launch criteria for the next roadmap slice. Target: 6 partners in 3 waves over 6 weeks. Thoughts?
Devon (Eng): 3 waves (2/2/2) makes sense. We should predefine integration tiers: "lite" (API only), "deep" (k8s + KV caching). Recommend default to lite to reduce infra work.
Ashwin (Solutions): Agree. For recruitment, prioritize customers with clear business metric owners and willingness to share a small labeled set (10-20 queries). That's golden for tuning.
Riley (Research): We need an eval matrix. Proposed signals: quality regressions (ablated prompts), throughput (req/s), cost delta per 1k tokens, and a simple user satisfaction survey (1-5) after each weekly demo.
Connie (Ops): Ops constraints: can support one "deep" onboarding at a time. Lite onboards x3 concurrently. We should cap deep slots to 1 per wave.
Priya (CS): From CS side, we can offer a joint customer success + solutions kickoff. Also suggest an intake form collecting: POC, data classification, expected spike windows, compliance needs.
Maya (PM): Good. Need hard acceptance gates for outreach copy. Draft gate list:
```
- Technical POC assigned
- Infra parity for chosen tier (API or k8s)
- Sample traffic profile + 1 representative payload
- NDA executed / basic security checklist
- Commitment to weekly 30m feedback demos
```
Ashwin (Solutions): For outreach incentives, propose: priority tuning, 8 weeks of trial credits (non-transferable), and a co-published case study option (opt-in). Helps get buy-in.
Riley (Research): Graduation (pilot->beta) criteria suggestion: median prompt regression <=3%, P95 latency <450ms, error rate <1.5% over 72h, and evidence of integration into partner staging flow.
Devon (Eng): Also add a stability gate: KV cache hit-rate > X for partners using caching. If not achievable, flag for follow-up optimization rather than blocking.
Connie (Ops): Legal note: don't promise SLA for trial credits. Offer "priority tuning" language only. Also ops will need a brief runbook created per partner before kickoff.
Maya (PM): Timeline and owners:
- Outreach & brief copy: Ashwin by Tue EOD
- Intake form + scheduling: Priya by Wed
- Runbook template: Connie by Fri
- Eval harness + control prompts: Riley by next Wed
- Sandbox quickstart (lite) + rollback notes: Devon by next Thu
Riley (Research): I'll assemble 12 control prompts (diverse) — want input from Ashwin on domain-specific cases.
Ashwin (Solutions): Will share 20 candidate partners; we'll rank by integration effort + business impact. I'll include contact intros.
Priya (CS): We'll pre-fill onboarding slots calendar — prefer Tues/Thurs for intake calls.
Maya (PM): Outreach draft (<150 chars) for review: "Join Redwood early program: 6 partners, 6 weeks. Priority tuning, trial credits, and shared results. 30m intake + 1wk sandbox. Limited slots. RSVP"
Connie (Ops): tweak: remove "trial credits" specifics; say "trial credits (terms apply)" or just "trial credits"? Legal warns. Suggest: "trial credits (terms apply)".
Maya (PM): I'll use "trial credits (terms apply)". Recruit-bot just flagged: new lead — "Marketly" (pm@marketly.io). Ashwin please add.
Ashwin (Solutions): Adding. Final question: when do we run partner demos internally? Recommend internal demo after week 2 of each partner's sandbox to triage issues early.
Devon (Eng): Agreed. Also document an automated fallback path to hosted model if partner sandbox fails compatibility tests, to keep momentum.
Maya (PM): Final actions: Ashwin shortlist + outreach draft, Priya intake form + schedule, Connie runbook template, Riley eval harness, Devon sandbox quickstart. Target outreach Thu next week. Will post updates here by Mon COB. :white_check_mark:
